body:
My experience with Adrafinil (Modafinil pro-drug) and benzos:
12:45 - 300mg Adrafinil sublingual. Only managed to keep it under my tongue for maybe 1 minute before gagging, so being unsure how much was actually absorbed, I took another 300mg capsule orally. So somewhere between 300 and 600mg.
5:00pm - Had a shit day, decided to chill out with benzos. 4mg klonopin (my tolerance is quite high, but 4mg should definitely have been noticable).
6pm - No effect. 2mg more klonopin.
6:45 - No effect. 2mg more klonopin.
8pm - No effect. 4mg more klonopin.
I decided to give up at that point.
Note: The klonopin is definitely not bunk, I've used it before and it definitely works.
Fast forward to ~1-2am. I decide to sleep. The adrafinil must have worn off and the klonopin must have still been active, because I woke up at 7pm, almost 18hrs of sleep, and I had a good sleep the night before.
[Erowid Note: 
The dose described in this report is very high, potentially beyond Erowid's 'heavy' range, and could pose serious health risks or result in unwanted, extreme effects. Sometimes extremely high doses reported are errors rather than actual doses used.]
